text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I chose this course because I wanted to see the view from that bridge over there, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever.
Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. had cold water thrown on her motivation in a rather unexpected way.
